Direct Access to Havelock MRT Station
Integrated Development with Restaurants, Supermarket and ECDC
Comprehensive facilities with Premier Residential Services

Premium Kitchen Appliances and Italian master wardrobe
Proximity to good schools Close to good schools e.g. River Valley Primary and Gan Eng Seng School
Efficient layouts and well-appointed interiors.
